title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1968-10-12
source: Recording Info: SBD -> ?? -> cdr -> wav via EAC -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent broadcast-quality recording of a powerful show, highlighted by a soaring Morning Dew and an emphatic Dark Star.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this version as a must‑have, noting that the tape they own matches the speed, crowd ambience and overall clarity of the upload. The performance shines with a dramatic Morning Dew (featuring Jerry’s brief falsetto) and a memorable Dark Star preceded by classic Dead banter.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews consistently praise both the musical performance and the sound quality, giving a near‑perfect combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear FM broadcast feed with consistent tape speed, minimal hiss, and preserved crowd chatter at the start; overall crisp and faithful to the original tape.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show opens with a striking Morning Dew that segues into Dark Star, maintaining high energy and featuring memorable pre‑song banter.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Adds a brief falsetto toward the end of Morning Dew; his playing is praised indirectly through the song’s impact.
